name: Nukun recipe-weighted composite noise
plain: Named recipes mix Gaussian, blue, violet, pink, brown and pyramid with weights that shift by a detail bias. The recipes have family names, such as Illustrious and Pony V7. Result is renormalized. Spectral part kills DC.
math:
Colored: scale=|f|^(−α/2), scale(0,0)=0; out=Re ifftn(F·scale).
Recipe e.g. Illustrious texture: gaussian .42, blue .22+.34·h, violet .10+.25·h, pyramid .28+.22·l; l=1−h; h=detail_bias. Components weighted and summed, then (x−mean)/std; then strength.

claims.text: Recipes named for Illustrious and Pony V7, no evidence for fit in code
